card.name: Dose reduction and modification wording
card.fires_on: The word "dose" (or a word just before it) in dose-adjustment instructions, such as dose reduction, dose interruption, dose modifications or dose level lower. It also fires on a few stray numbers in tables.

modes.label: Dose before adjustment terms
modes.description: The word dose or a linking word like upon right before reduction, modification or interruption.
modes.example: Institute<< dose>> modifications or permanently discontinue as appropriate.

modes.label: Table numbers
modes.description: A lone digit or space inside a lab or results table.

card.plain: It lights up on the word dose when a label tells you how to lower, hold or change a dose after side effects.
